public class UniversalCompactDetAutomaton<I,SP,TP> extends UniversalCompactDet<I,SP,TP> implements MutableDeterministic.RegularAutomaton<Integer,I,CompactTransition<TP>,SP,TP>
A refinement of UniversalCompactDet that additionally implements MutableDeterministic.RegularAutomaton so that structural determinism and finiteness coincides with semantic determinism and finiteness.
